guidance.heading: Start from the pump and the liner
guidance.body: Pistons go by liner size, series and rod fit (API taper on double-acting pistons, straight bore on single-acting); valves and seats by API series 6 or 7, matched to the pump model; dampener diaphragms by dampener model and pressure.

standards.heading: API-design parts from Houston
standards.body: Oteco makes premium fabric-backed and bonded urethane pistons interchangeable with other API-design pistons, wing-guided valves with carburised bodies and snap-on polyurethane inserts, and one-piece moulded dampener diaphragms.

items.q: Bonded urethane or premium rubber piston?
items.a: Bonded urethane lasts longer in abrasive fluids and oil-based mud, but needs ample liner cooling water; premium fabric-backed rubber suits the widest range of conditions.

items.q: Which valve and seat fit my pump?
items.a: Oteco lists its valves, seats and springs by pump maker and model — Continental Emsco, Gardner Denver, Ideco, National, OPI-Gist, Oilwell and Skytop Brewster. The valves and seats listing has the full selection table.

products.title: Oteco Double-Acting Mud Pump Pistons
products.descriptionShort: Oteco Double-Acting Mud Pump Pistons: double-acting premium piston assemblies for duplex mud pumps, 3" to 8" liners, series A, B, K and L, with API 3 to 6 or GD1 taper bores — 82 part numbers by liner size, series and rod fit. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
Double-acting premium piston assemblies for duplex mud pumps, 3" to 8" liners, series A, B, K and L, with API 3 to 6 or GD1 taper bores.

Oteco makes two piston constructions for triplex and duplex mud pumps:

  • Premium pistons — rubbers with a multi-ply, fabric-reinforced backing that gives positive, wear-resistant seals with high tensile strength and resistance to chemicals, hydrocarbons and abrasion. Oteco states that they are fully interchangeable with other API-design pistons.
  • Bonded urethane pistons — a harder, denser polyurethane bonded to the hub in place of fabric-backed rubber. They resist abrasive fluids, chemicals and oil-based muds of varying aniline point, and give long life in triplex pumps that have ample liner cooling water.

Choose the piston by the liner size (the piston OD), the series (hub size — see the table), and the rod fit: double-acting pistons are bored with an API taper (API 3 to 6) or a GD1 taper; single-acting pistons have a 1-inch or a 1-1/2-inch or 1-5/8-inch straight bore.

Oteco piston series

products.title: Oteco Mud Pump Valves & Seats — Wing-Guided, Full-Open, API 6 & 7
products.descriptionShort: Oteco premium wing-guided mud pump valves, full-open seats, springs, polyurethane inserts and seat puller heads in API 6 and API 7 series, for 40 triplex and duplex pump models — 15 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
Oteco's premium wing-guided valve and full-open seat are made in API 6 and API 7 series for most popular mud pumps:

  • A uni-body valve with a snap-on polyurethane insert — no snap rings, plates or keepers to fail — and a carburised body for longer life and lower maintenance.
  • A seating angle and full-open seat design that improve flow through the seat and pass lost-circulation material better than conventional valves and seats.
  • A full-open seat that is easier to service in valve-over-valve fluid ends and carries a heavy bearing load.

Each valve must be used with its matching full-open spring. Inserts and seat puller heads are listed separately for each series.

products.title: Oteco Pulsation Dampener Diaphragms & Parts — K-10, K-20
products.descriptionShort: Oteco replacement diaphragms and parts for Hydril and Mattco K-10 and K-20 pulsation dampeners — NBR 5,000 psi (K-10, K-20) and HNBR 7,500 psi (K-20) diaphragms, stabilizers, plates, gauge, charging valve, gaskets — plus the Continental Emsco PD-55 diaphragm. 15 part numbers. Authorised Oteco distributor, UAE stock.
products.descriptionLong:
Oteco makes most replacement parts for Hydril and Mattco K-10 (10 gallon) and K-20 (20 gallon) pulsation dampeners on the mud pump discharge. Diaphragms are moulded in one piece down to the bottom flange, with a metal insert moulded into the bottom so the rubber cannot extrude into the bottom-flange connection. Oteco makes diaphragms for 1,500, 3,000, 5,000 and 7,500 psi service. The part numbers listed here are nitrile (NBR) diaphragms to 5,000 psi for the K-10 and K-20, and a hydrogenated nitrile (HNBR) diaphragm to 7,500 psi for the K-20. The stabilizer, stabilizer plate, screw and lock washer are needed only for the 1,500 psi range.

The size table also lists the 316 stainless 0–6,000 psi gauge, the brass charging valve with bull plug, the bottom plate gasket, the K-20 bottom plate (4-1/16 in 5,000 psi, R-39) and a diaphragm for the Continental Emsco PD-55 dampener.

Pre-charge the dampener with nitrogen only, to the pressure the pump maker specifies for the operating pressure; never use air or oxygen.

Pump and swivel makers' names are trademarks of their owners. Oteco parts are replacement parts made to fit that equipment; Indus Hydraulics is not affiliated with those makers.
